tools.name: Karin character-replacement builder (build_kratos_final.py / build_valk_final.py and modules)
tools.role: geometry assembly, slot planning, in-place MESH writing, hidden-mesh block, single-group patch lodpack

tools.name: verify_build.py / knee_sim.py
tools.role: per-vertex read-back of positions, joints, weights and triangles; knee-flex check of the Freya build

tools.name: build_textures.py / build_valk_textures.py
tools.role: 4096 atlas, per-slot texture plan, BCn compression (etcpak) and patch texpack writing

tools.name: libSceAgcTextureTool.dll (ships with the game)
tools.role: PS5 (AGC) texture tiling and detiling, loaded from the game folder on first use; Windows only

tools.name: Blender
tools.role: pose fitting (blender/fit_karin.py), distance-LOD decimation (blender/decimate_levels.py), bone table (blender/dump_bones.py)
